title.narrative: for Synergy of Actions for Participatory and Inclusive Governance in Senegal (SAPIGS)

description.narrative: The Union of Associative and Community Radios of Senegal (URAC) unites over 130 community radio stations across all 14 regions of the country, broadcasting in every local language. URAC makes community radio a tool for citizen participation in public debate by promoting community-driven content that reflects listeners’ needs and priorities; and serving as a platform for capacity-building and advocacy with authorities and partners. With this support, URAC will strengthen radio capacities to produce content that promotes inclusive governance, to deliver accurate information to communities, and to foster spaces for participatory dialogue.
